# Kirubel Daniel

> Kirubel Daniel is a full-stack product builder and digital systems developer based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. He builds web applications, mobile products, SaaS systems, business automation, and operational software.

Canonical website: https://kiraweb.pro.et/
Contact: contact@kiraweb.pro.et

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://kiraweb.pro.et/): Official biography, capabilities, contact details, and selected products.
- [Selected work](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/): Index of Kirubel Daniel's product and case-study work.
- [KirzKit](https://github.com/kirawebdesigner/KirzKit): Open-source developer tooling project maintained by Kirubel Daniel.

## Services

- [Web application development](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/web-application-development/): Product structure, responsive frontend, backend, databases, deployment, and QA.
- [SaaS product development](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/saas-product-development/): Multi-tenant products, subscriptions, permissions, administration, and backend systems.
- [Business automation](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/business-automation/): Operational workflows, integrations, approvals, notifications, and data movement.
- [Mobile application development](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/mobile-applications/): Mobile product flows, interfaces, connected backends, testing, and release readiness.
- [Internal management systems](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/internal-management-systems/): Operational records, staff roles, approvals, reporting, and controlled workflows.
- [Realtime product experiences](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/realtime-product-experiences/): Live updates, notifications, synchronized data, and resilient user feedback.
- [Backend API development](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/backend-api-development/): Product logic, validation, permissions, integrations, and production reliability.
- [Database architecture](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/database-architecture/): Data models, relationships, constraints, access patterns, and migrations.
- [Authentication and permissions](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/authentication-permissions/): Identity, roles, authorization, sessions, and tenant boundaries.
- [Deployment and production QA](https://kiraweb.pro.et/services/deployment-production-qa/): Hosting configuration, security, performance, accessibility, and release validation.

## Selected case studies

- [Zewijuna](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/zewijuna/): Mobile and web matchmaking product.
- [YourCloser](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/yourcloser/): Telegram commerce automation SaaS.
- [Dental Management System](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/dms/): Clinic administration and operations system.
- [Pommy](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/pommy/): Restaurant ordering and commerce website.
- [Majestic Trading PLC](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/majestic/): Corporate services website.
- [KiraEstate](https://kiraweb.pro.et/work/kiraestate/): Real-estate discovery and inquiry experience.
